changes.title: Creature spell glow
items: Creatures' spells glow: a bright core with a pixel halo, a pool of light on the ground under each shot, hit and zone, and the brightest few light the forest around them
Legends' blows and party animals' spells glow too, in their own colours; Reduce flashing halves the glow

changes.title: Invite reach
items: Your 💌 invitations fly faster and further (45 m/s for 42 m, up from 31.2 m/s for 33 m) and home in from further off, so they catch running animals
Animals waiting in a fight keep the same distance as before, so the longer throws now reach them
To compare with the old invitations, add ?invites=old to the link

changes.title: Haunted music
items: The quiet stretches of the music are haunted: the singer floats in a long, dark reverb over a slow drone, holding her notes, with a ghostly second voice a sixth below her and darker notes at the ends of phrases
Each quiet stretch then drops into drum & bass
A sleeping legend's clearing has the same dark reverb, drone and ghostly echo, and no drums

changes.title: Chimera singer
items: A new singer: the voice in the breakdowns and builds now sings with Chimera's voice, a note made for every pitch it sings, on "ah" and "ooh", so every note is in tune
To compare with the old singer, add ?singer=recorded to the link; the Music Lab's voice choice has both
